name: Calendar day agenda
summary: One day's schedule: a date header with previous, today and next, an all-day event, and timed events on an hour rail with overlaps side by side and a now line.
use: for one day's events in a scheduling or CRM tool
a11y: Events are links in a labelled list with the title, time and place in their text; the hour rail is hidden from screen readers and the now line has a text label.
